aiReview.method: Direct translation from every effective Japanese prompt, all four options, all four option-specific reasons, supplied passage and supplied figure description. Source correctIndex, stable IDs and revisions preserved. Used no other locale as input. Read Japanese and target question groups, then reviewed Chinese prose and expanded clipped phrases in a targeted followup.
specificChecks: All12forms are existing project-authored mock forms, not newly authored additional exams.
Japanese-mock04q03 follows corrected effective source: one option means actual urination rather than repeating urinary urge; correctIndex1 retained.
All60passages preserve speaker roles, specific dates/times, negation, requested scope, pending versus completed operations; no explanation/model answer inserted into passages.
30figure descriptions preserve letters, IDs and conditional figure statements; width70cm is a question condition, not universal device or legal standard; image pixels and embedded labels unchanged.

Clinical conditions, medical-professional reporting recipients, individual plans, facility/device/training conditions retained; unilateral diagnosis/treatment/medication/device procedures not introduced.

Chinese respectful adult address retained where source uses care dialogue; source multiple choice fragments remain parallel. Body side is person-relative; constipation/aspiration/choking/dysphagia terminology distinguishes mechanisms.
aiReview.proseFollowupEvidence: Private drafts/mock-prose-polish-log.json records exact before/after at question-field granularity; semantic decisions checked against direct Japanese only.

limits: AI translation and semantic/style comparison only; independent human, professional and native-language review still required.
Descriptions translate source text; embedded fixed image lettering was not changed or approved.
No native device/runtime test performed by language author; root imports private handoff and runs application-specific runtime validation.
No Japanese source/other locale/UI/shared assets modified; no commit by language author.
Record counts and passing structural checks are not claims of unique textbook knowledge coverage or release approval.
